skill.summary: Guides users to set realistic, meaningful fitness goals with actionable weekly steps, measurable milestones, review plans, and setback resilience strategies.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Fitness Goal Setting Framework skill.
- Guides users through reflective, health-centered fitness goal setting using proven frameworks.
- Supports creation of specific, actionable, and adaptable goals that go beyond vague intentions.
- Integrates a hierarchy of goals (annual, quarterly, monthly, weekly) and built-in resilience for setbacks.
- Emphasizes user-defined meaning and prioritizes overall well-being over aesthetics.
- Includes clear safety and scope boundaries, promoting professional support where appropriate.
